units.source_text: 噩耗传来，左大臣及源氏公子等大吃一惊，慌忙退出，几乎足不履地。

en.t: When the terrible news arrived, the Minister of the Left, Prince Genji, and the others were deeply shocked and hurriedly withdrew, scarcely able to keep their feet on the ground.

units.source_text: 原定这天晚上办理“司召”，现在发生了这意外的故障，只得万事中止了。

en.t: The appointments ceremony had originally been scheduled for that evening, but with this unexpected calamity, everything had to be called off.
